market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$65,100 (+3.7% in 24h, +10% in July). Recovered from $58K late-June low. 3-week high on soft CPI+PPI data.
market_summary.sentiment: Extreme Fear — Fear & Greed Index 23 (improving). Price rising while sentiment stays depressed = contrarian bullish signal / possible seller exhaustion.

market_summary.technicals: Short-term bullish: +3.7% today on CPI/PPI relief, 3-week high, broke above $65K. Medium-term: structural downtrend from $93K (Jan high) still intact.
market_summary.fed_stance: FOMC on hold at 3.50-3.75%. Next decision July 29. Soft CPI/PPI raised H2 2026 rate-cut expectations. Warsh testimony (hawkish lean) is today's key risk.
